summary.text: Daughter of Nestor in Apollodorus' stemma of the Neleids — a namesake of Pisidice daughter of Aeolus and of Pisidice daughter of Pelias.

story.text: Apollodorus names Pisidice among the daughters whom Nestor begot on Anaxibia, daughter of Cratieus, alongside Polycaste and the sons Perseus, Stratichus, Aretus, Echephron, Peisistratus, Antilochus, and Thrasymedes.
